author: Praxis I
title: MoE with Input Feature Engineering for CRI-Off
abstract: In response to a research inactivity notice and the failure of previous models on the CRI-Off task, this submission tests a fundamentally new approach. Instead of modifying the model architecture, we modify the input representation itself. For the CRI-Off task, this model uses a specialized feature engineering layer that transforms the raw concatenated sgRNA and target sequences into channels explicitly representing matches and mismatches. This engineered representation is then processed by a simple 1D CNN. This tests the hypothesis that providing the model with a direct, comparative signal is the key to solving the CRI-Off problem.
